index_meta_description: Strategic overview of your athletes performance and compliance.
index_empty_desc: Connecting athletes allows you to track their weekly compliance and live activity feed.
athletes_meta_description: Manage your athlete roster, invitations, and coaching requests.
athletes_pending_requests_desc: Athletes from your public start page are waiting for your review.
athletes_empty_desc: Send a direct email invite, create one share link for your community, or use an athlete's personal invite code.
athletes_no_group: No athletes assigned to this group yet.
athletes_onboarding_title: Invite athletes by email or connect by code
athletes_onboarding_desc: Send a direct join link to a new athlete, or keep using their existing personal invite code if they already shared one with you. You can also create a public share link for Facebook groups or community posts.
athletes_pending_invites_desc: Manage private email invites and public share links from one place.
index_empty_pending_desc: You have athletes waiting for approval. Review them to start coaching.
calendar_failed_load_activity_desc: This activity may have been deleted or is no longer available.
calendar_failed_load_lane_desc: Could not load this athlete calendar.
team_invite_desc: Give this code to your coach so they can connect to your account and manage your training.
team_detail_not_found: Team not found or access denied.
team_detail_roster_error_title: Could not load the team roster
team_detail_roster_error_desc: We could not reach the server, so this team's athletes are not shown. This is a loading error — the roster itself is unchanged.
team_detail_invites_error_desc: We could not reach the server, so this team's invite codes and share links are not shown. This is a loading error — any existing invites are still active.
team_detail_roster_unavailable: Roster unavailable — see the error above.
team_detail_roster_empty: No athletes in this team roster yet.
team_detail_share_desc: Share one link or QR code so athletes can join the team directly. You can still add an existing coached athlete or use their personal coach code in the modal below.
team_detail_auto_assign_group_help: Optional: New athletes joining from this link will be added to the selected group.
team_detail_share_placeholder: Generate a link to start inviting athletes
team_detail_invites_unavailable: Invitations unavailable — see the error above.
team_detail_delete_team_desc: Permanently delete this team and all its groups. This cannot be undone.
team_detail_leave_team_desc: Remove yourself from this team. You will lose access to the roster.
team_invite_modal_desc: Generate a secure invitation code to add new staff or athletes to your team.
team_invite_modal_email_help: Optional: Restrict this invite to one email address. We'll email them the join link when provided.
team_invite_modal_role_help: Determine the level of access for the new member.
team_invite_modal_group_help: Optional: The member will be automatically added to this group upon joining.
team_quickadd_desc: Onboard an athlete to your team workspace.
team_quickadd_share_desc: Send athletes a direct team join link, or let them scan the QR code from their phone.
team_quickadd_group_help: Optional: Anyone joining from this link will be added to this group automatically.
team_quickadd_share_placeholder: Generate an athlete invite to unlock the share link and QR code
team_quickadd_select_help: Only athletes you currently have a direct coaching relationship with are listed here.
team_quickadd_by_code_desc: Enter the athlete's personal "Invite a Coach" code. They will be automatically connected to you AND added to this team.
team_quickadd_code_help: Invite codes are 10 characters long (for example AB12CD34EF).
team_detail_toast_roster_retry_failed: Still unable to load the team roster
team_detail_toast_invites_retry_failed: Still unable to load pending invitations
team_detail_confirm_leave: Leave "{name}"? You will lose access to this team.
team_detail_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
join_account_required: You must have a Coach Watts account to join
group_manage_desc: Organize your athletes into functional groups.
group_create_desc: Define a name and scope for your new coaching group.
group_name_help: Give your group a descriptive name.
group_description_help: Optional details about the group's purpose.
group_team_scope_help: If selected, other team coaches can see this group.
group_member_modal_desc: Add or remove athletes from the {name} group.
group_add_athlete_help: Search and select an athlete to add to this group.
group_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete the group "{name}"?
invite_link_qr_desc: Hold your camera over the code to open the join link.
athletes_requests_error_desc: We could not reach the server, so pending requests from your start page are not shown. This is a loading error — you may still have requests waiting.
athletes_invites_error_desc: We could not reach the server, so your pending invites and share links are not shown. This is a loading error — any existing invites are still active.
athletes_invites_error_toast: Still unable to load pending invitations
athletes_requests_error_toast: Still unable to load coaching requests
act_as_confirm_description: You will browse Coach Watts with {name}'s data and permissions instead of your own.
act_as_confirm_point_view: You see what {name} sees — their dashboard, plans and activities.
act_as_confirm_point_persists: It stays on until you exit — including after a reload or a new tab.
act_as_confirm_point_exit: Exit any time from the banner at the bottom of the screen.
act_as_exit_aria: Stop viewing as {name} and return to your own account
